party_a_statement: I vacated the flat on October 1 2025 after giving 30 days notice. The flat was clean and in good condition. I have photos from move-out day. The landlord has not returned my security deposit of 50000 INR despite three written requests via WhatsApp. It has been 3 months since I vacated.
party_b_statement: The tenant left on October 3 two days after the agreed date without informing me. The flat was damaged with wall marks a broken ceiling fan and cracked bathroom tiles. I have had the repairs done at a cost of 45000 INR and I have the invoices. The deposit was 50000 INR and I am deducting repair costs.
